name: What are common signs of a bathroom leak?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a bathroom leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a bathroom leak include water stains on ceilings or walls, peeling paint or wallpaper, warped flooring, musty odors, and continuously running toilets. Increased water bills without a change in usage can also indicate a hidden leak. Early detection is key to preventing extensive damage, and CG Plumbing Solutions recommends checking around your toilet, shower, and sink for any visible moisture or dampness regularly.
